name: dao-browser
description: Use Dao Lite for background web tasks, or Dao Browser for explicitly requested existing tabs.

interface.shortDescription: Work in the user's Dao browser
interface.longDescription: Use dao-lite for searches and multi-step web tasks in background windows with your sign-ins. Use dao-browser only for existing tabs you explicitly choose to share. You can watch, take over, or stop background tasks from the sidebar.
defaultPrompt: Use dao-lite to open https://example.com in a background task and report its title.
